observed_state.selected_profile: II. zivilrechtliche Abteilung des Schweizerischen Bundesgerichts

limitations.description: Verified corpus contains only 8 full-text official decisions, below the 50-case minimum.
limitations.probable_cause: Manual discovery and single-case resolution do not scale.
limitations.impact: Day 1 output remains PARTIAL and cannot support representative style claims.
limitations.proposed_solution: Build official corpus workflow with discovery, batch resolution, checkpoint and export.
tests_needed: offline corpus fixture with at least 60 candidates
limitations.acceptance_criterion: A run produces at least 50 full_text_verified_official decisions for configured chamber/language/period.

limitations.description: Current search_cases uses an unofficial aggregator and cannot be the official corpus authority.
limitations.evidence: judge-selection.md says aggregators were used only for discovery; entscheidsucheTools.ts warns search_cases is not official.
limitations.probable_cause: Existing jurisprudence search provider is entscheidsuche.ch.
limitations.impact: Every search result requires follow-up official verification.
limitations.proposed_solution: Add official federal discovery instead of overloading aggregator semantics.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Official federal discovery returns official Swiss Federal Supreme Court candidates without using aggregators as authority.

limitations.description: No dedicated official federal case search surface exists.
limitations.evidence: Day 1 used search_cases plus resolve_official_swiss_case; no search_federal_cases tool is recorded.
limitations.probable_cause: Resolver verifies known references but does not enumerate official search results.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Tool discovers official federal candidates by query, language, date and chamber.

limitations.description: Chamber filtering is not first-class in search.
limitations.evidence: SearchCasesParams has court/canton/date/language/page but no chamber; corpus manually selected II. civil division.
limitations.probable_cause: Chamber metadata is detected after resolution, not during discovery.
limitations.proposed_solution: Add validated chamber filter to official federal discovery and corpus export.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Corpus filter can target II. civil division without manual filtering.

limitations.description: Judge/composition filtering cannot support authorship claims.
limitations.evidence: judge-selection.md rejects individual judge style; style-analysis.md says composition is not authorship.
limitations.probable_cause: Official source exposes composition but not drafting judge.
limitations.proposed_solution: Permit composition-presence filtering only with no_authorship_inference warning.
tests_needed: composition match does not set author match
limitations.acceptance_criterion: No output attributes style or text to an individual judge unless official authorship exists.

limitations.description: BGE citations can resolve to official extracts that are not full-text case records.
limitations.evidence: corpus.json excludes BGE 133 III 350 and BGE 134 III 332 for missing dispositive.
limitations.probable_cause: Official report pages and underlying case pages are separate official surfaces.
limitations.impact: BGE citations cannot always be counted in full-text corpus without mapping.
limitations.proposed_solution: Expose BGE-to-underlying-case mapping status in resolver; add separate tool only if necessary.
tests_needed: official extract not counted as full text
limitations.acceptance_criterion: BGE resolution separates official report status from full-text underlying case status.

limitations.description: Pagination is inefficient for massive discovery.
limitations.evidence: entscheidsucheProvider.ts documents O(page) sequential cursor advancement for search_cases.
limitations.impact: Large corpus discovery through aggregator is slow and fragile.
limitations.proposed_solution: Use cursor/checkpoint official discovery instead of random page emulation.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Corpus discovery resumes from stored cursor without replaying all earlier pages.

limitations.evidence: Day 1 manually resolved individual references; resolve_official_swiss_case input accepts one reference.
limitations.probable_cause: Existing resolver is optimized for single legal-use verification.
limitations.proposed_solution: Add batch_resolve_official_cases or internal batch helper with controlled concurrency.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Batch output preserves per-item statuses and never fails all items because one item fails.

limitations.description: Deduplication is manual at corpus level.
limitations.evidence: metadata.json records duplicates_detected=0 but no corpus tool generated that result.
limitations.probable_cause: Resolver handles candidates, not full corpus deduplication.
limitations.impact: Joined proceedings and BGE/case overlaps can inflate counts.
limitations.proposed_solution: Deduplicate by normalized reference, canonical URL, official docid and hashes.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Export reports duplicate groups and counts only canonical included records.

limitations.description: Status classes are available but not normalized by corpus export.
limitations.evidence: corpus.json manually separates included, comparators and excluded records.
limitations.probable_cause: No corpus schema maps resolver legal-use statuses into dataset inclusion decisions.
limitations.impact: Large runs can accidentally count official extracts or metadata-only records.
limitations.proposed_solution: Define corpus statuses for full_text_verified_official, official_extract, metadata_only and secondary_source.
tests_needed: blocked statuses excluded from included count
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Exported counts distinguish included official full text from all other source states.

limitations.evidence: corpus.json excludes 5A_154/2014 because a German-profile request resolved a French document with language mismatch warning.
limitations.probable_cause: Portal/interface language and actual decision language can diverge.
limitations.impact: German corpus may be contaminated by French/Italian decisions.
limitations.proposed_solution: Apply strict post-fetch document language gate.
tests_needed: German requested but French document excluded
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Included corpus entries all match requested document language.

limitations.description: Matter and period selection were manual.
limitations.evidence: corpus.json includes mixed subjects and no structured period criteria beyond individual dates.
limitations.probable_cause: No corpus filter schema for subject/remedy/period distribution.
limitations.impact: Style corpus can mix ordinary merits and simplified non-entry decisions.
limitations.proposed_solution: Add corpus criteria for date range, remedy type, subject keywords and simplified-procedure flag.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Corpus export records filters and matter distribution.

limitations.evidence: Day 1 corpus.json was manually created and no export_case_corpus tool is recorded.
limitations.probable_cause: Current tools focus on lookup and legal verification, not dataset assembly.
limitations.impact: Challenge reruns are not fully reproducible.
limitations.proposed_solution: Create export_case_corpus after official search and batch resolution stabilize.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: A single export contains included, excluded, filters, counts, source policy, hashes and warnings.

limitations.description: Timeouts and performance are not managed at workload level.
limitations.evidence: metadata.json contains no run timing/checkpoint; Day 1 used individual long timeout policies during resolution.
limitations.impact: Large live corpus runs can fail midway.
limitations.proposed_solution: Add scheduler with concurrency limit, retry budget, backoff and checkpoint.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: A simulated 60-case run completes with recorded per-item timeout outcomes.

limitations.description: Per-document traceability is not fully preserved in corpus artifact.
limitations.evidence: corpus.json includes URLs and document_id but omits resolution_id, hashes, retrieved_at and cache_status for each included case.
limitations.probable_cause: Manual artifact did not copy full resolver trace output.
limitations.impact: Later audit may require live re-resolution.
limitations.proposed_solution: Export resolver trace fields for every included and excluded item.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Every corpus entry includes resolution_id, hashes, timestamp, cache status and warnings.

limitations.description: Individual authorship is not available from official source.
limitations.probable_cause: Official judgments list composition but not drafting author.
limitations.impact: Individual judge style cannot be supported.
limitations.proposed_solution: Keep individual style unsupported and document institutional-only scope.
probable_code_files: documentation only unless composition filters are added
limitations.acceptance_criterion: No corpus or style output claims individual authorship.

limitations.description: Statutes were verified only at law-version level.
limitations.evidence: example-brief.md says article-level application must be checked against Fedlex before real filing.
limitations.probable_cause: Day 1 did not perform article-level extraction.
limitations.proposed_solution: Require article-level retrieval for future filing-style examples.
tests_needed: article lookup by ELI and article number
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Article citations are either article-verified or explicitly law-level only.

limitations.description: Selection gates for full text, official extract, metadata-only and secondary source are manual.
limitations.evidence: corpus.json excludes BGE extracts, metadata-only, language mismatch and missing dispositive entries.
limitations.probable_cause: Resolver statuses are not yet enforced by a corpus builder.
limitations.impact: Large corpus could count unsuitable records.
limitations.proposed_solution: Implement hard corpus inclusion gates based on resolver legal-use status.
limitations.acceptance_criterion: Only verified official complete full-text decisions count toward corpus target.

extend_search_cases.reason: It is aggregator-based; official federal discovery should not blur this contract.

add_chamber_filters.reason: Needed for homogeneous II. civil division corpus.

add_judge_or_composition_filters.reason: Composition can be filtered, authorship cannot be inferred.

create_resolve_bge_to_case.reason: Prefer extending resolve_official_swiss_case with BGE mapping first.

create_batch_resolve_official_cases.reason: Needed to resolve 60 references without manual calls.

create_export_case_corpus.reason: Needed for reproducible corpus artifacts and selection gates.

recovery_strategy_for_60.discovery: Use official Swiss Federal Supreme Court search, over-collect 100-140 candidates.
recovery_strategy_for_60.deduplication: Deduplicate by normalized reference, canonical URL, official docid, document hash and joined proceedings.
recovery_strategy_for_60.official_resolution: Resolve with require_official_source, require_full_text, strict_identity_match and German language hint.
recovery_strategy_for_60.concurrency: Use 2-4 concurrent live requests with provider-specific rate limits.
recovery_strategy_for_60.retries: Use 1-2 retries for transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter.
recovery_strategy_for_60.checkpoint: Persist after every candidate: cursor, processed refs, included/excluded refs and warnings.
recovery_strategy_for_60.validation: Require identity_verified, official source, complete full-text, German language and no duplicates.
recovery_strategy_for_60.export: Write corpus, exclusions, source policy, trace manifest and counts.

recommended_first_fix: Implement official federal discovery with chamber/language/date filters, then connect it to batch resolution and corpus export.
